nodes.summary: Evaluations and bounds of sums of products of binomial coefficients: Chu–Vandermonde, Dixon, Knuth's old sum, Staver, Frisch, Klamkin, hockey-stick and Filipponi identities, partial-sum bounds, multisection identities, and Franel, Domb, Zagier and Catalan–Larcombe–French numbers defined by binomial sums.
nodes.title: Binomial sums and hypergeometric identities

nodes.summary: Finite sums and power series involving central binomial coefficients or their reciprocals, often weighted by harmonic or odd harmonic numbers, including arcsin-type series and Kollár's incomplete binomial sums.
nodes.title: Central binomial coefficients and harmonic sums

nodes.summary: Variants of the binomial coefficient and of Pascal's triangle: b-ary and digital (carry-free) binomial coefficients, Ward and totienomial coefficients from generalized factorials, trinomial and quadrinomial coefficients, rascal, hyperbolic Pascal and 2-Pascal triangles and their diagonals; the Pascal matrix viewed as a Riordan array goes to Riordan arrays.
nodes.title: Generalized binomial coefficients and Pascal-like triangles

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
